summary_en: This Phase 1 trial tests tagraxofusp combined with azacitidine as maintenance therapy after a donor stem cell transplant in people with CD123-positive acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome. Both drugs are given into a vein (IV): tagraxofusp over 15 minutes once daily on days 1 to 3, and azacitidine once daily on days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 6 cycles. The study measures safety, side effects, best dose and effectiveness, as described in the record.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa tagraxofusp combinado con azacitidina como terapia de mantenimiento después de un trasplante de células madre de donante, en personas con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndrome mielodisplásico positivos para CD123. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vena (IV): tagraxofusp durante 15 minutos una vez al día los días 1 a 3, y azacitidina una vez al día los días 1 a 5 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 6 ciclos. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios, la mejor dosis y la efectividad, según describe el registro.
who_for: Acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome with high-risk features, or minimal residual disease positive at transplant, after a first or second donor tr
CD123 positive on flow cytometry at diagnosis or before transplant.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Complete response or minimal residual disease positive on day 30 bone marrow biopsy, and fully recovered blood counts after transplant.
not_for: History of allergic reaction to compounds similar to tagraxofusp or azacitidine.
Active malignancy, or recent cancer history with substantial potential for recurrence.
Clinically significant heart disease, uncontrolled lung disease, or known active or suspected central nervous system disease.
Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV infection.
